rounds.text: Fonebox Retail Ltd displays exceptional fundamental momentum, highlighted by a compounded sales growth rate of 252% over 5 years and a 56% expansion over the trailing twelve months [E14, E16]. Profitability metrics are equally robust, featuring a 5-year compounded profit growth of 98% alongside a trailing twelve-month profit growth of 49% [E17, E19]. The company's balance sheet is pristine, boasting a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.00x as borrowings were entirely eliminated down to Rs 0 Cr, complemented by an impressive cash conversion of 1.57x where operating cash flow fully backs reported profit [E28, E32, E33]. Furthermore, insiders have demonstrated strong conviction as promoter holdings increased to 73.41% in Mar 2026, supported by a favorable Consumer Services sector tailwind score of +0.84 [E35, E63]. Valuation presents a compelling entry point relative to operational performance, with a reverse DCF indicating that the current market price only prices in a modest 1.7% earnings growth against a base-case assumption of 18.0% [E41]. Conceded: [E4] Dividend yield is 0.00%.
